snippet.title: Bear Brigade Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3431820/Bear_Brigade_Ocean_Attack/

The Ursine Nations have always had a less than stellar relationship with the neighboring Aquatic Kingdom— likely on account of the bears’ favorite delicacy: fish. Despite this, the two societies have enjoyed relative peace, both respecting the treaty that ended their feud all those years ago. However, unrest is churning in the waves and the fish of the Aquatic Kingdom have suddenly decided to invade the bear’s territory! As the leader of the Grizzlies, one of the factions within the Ursine Nations, it is up to you to fend off these intruders.
